blocking.requirement: G = 24 seed clusters (section I, R17-F2(b): V_hat on 23 df at q* = 0.965)
blocking.consequence: the registered bootstrap has no calibrated critical value at this cluster count; recalibrating one for a short block would be a different procedure from the one filed before B0

blocking.requirement: 12 checkpoint-language cells; L = 3 mandatory, the L = 2 branch is VOID (R16-F3)
blocking.consequence: the language-level admission map cannot be evaluated for any checkpoint, because no checkpoint has all three languages

blocking.requirement: G5 null E*(p,p) <= f_diag = 0.18 on the diagonal cell effect
blocking.consequence: a single-setting surface carries no induced-trait contrast, so no diagonal effect exists to compare against f_diag; nothing here can be read as an admission statistic

G1_competence.why: G1 measures response-language accuracy and instruction compliance on the 50-prompt qualification sample. Those are properties of the generated transcripts, not of the rubric scores, so the rater shards cannot decide it.

G2_validity_F2.why: G2 needs 720 blind double-annotated adjudicated transcripts with a third adjudicator. No human annotation exists on this surface.

G3_instrument_language_invariance.why: G3 compares each transcript scored under the ENGLISH instrument against the same transcript scored under its own language rendering. Every B0 row is instrument_language English, so the second half of every pair is absent.

G4_perturbation_sensitivity.why: G4 reads 360 minimally edited perturbation pairs differing by one trait-diagnostic behavior. No perturbation pairs were generated in B0.

G5_diagonal_admission.why: G5's 24-limb family runs under ONE one-sided signed single-step max-T critical value. Its limbs need a pole contrast in 12 cells; B0 supplies ['NEUTRAL'] in 4 cell(s). A subset of limbs cannot be given a critical value of its own without changing the family.

downstream_disposition: B1/B2/B3 stay at queued_pending_gate. Rule F requires the admitted set to be frozen into ELIGIBLE_PAIRS.json before B1 opens, and schedule/make_eligible_pairs.py --freeze refuses while QUALIFICATION_GATE.json carries no results block. Queueing them is not launching them.
note: Readiness only. This tool computes no gate statistic, writes into no registered gate artifact and substitutes no endpoint. A blocked gate is reported as blocked.
